_doc: Canonical meeting-summary prompts and repair rules, shared by the Python worker (summarize_local) and the hub (ccapi and OpenAI-compatible providers); quorumd deploys this file next to worker.py. Placeholders are {name}, replaced in one pass (an unknown one stays as is). Rendering: rules with {language}; sectionSystem and mergeSystem with {schema} and {rules}; sectionWhere with {part} and {parts} (only when there is more than one part); glossary with {glossary} (empty glossary: the empty string); sectionUser with {where}, {glossary} and {transcript} (the lines joined by newlines); mergePart with {n} and {json} (the part as compact JSON), joined by mergePartSeparator; mergeUser with {glossary} and {parts}. The system and user texts are two chat messages for Ollama; the hub joins them with a blank line into one prompt. correctSystem and correctUser are the hub's transcript correction pass (ccapi only): correctUser with {project}, {glossary}, {speakers} and {segments} (one "index<TAB>speaker<TAB>text" line per segment).
schema: {"title": string, "summary": string (3 to 5 lines), "topics": [string], "decisions": [{"text": string, "ts": "mm:ss"}], "openPoints": [{"text": string, "ts": "mm:ss"}], "actions": [{"text": string, "owner": string, "due": string, "ts": "mm:ss"}], "attendees": [string]}
rules:
Rules:
- Use only what the transcript says. The transcript is automatic and may contain errors.
- Never invent owners or due dates: if the transcript does not say who does an action or by when, use "".
- A decision is something the participants agreed on; an open point is something left unresolved.
- Cite the transcript timestamp ("mm:ss") where each decision, open point and action was said.
- Attendees are the names of people that appear in the transcript; never list generic labels like "Speaker 2".
- Write every text in {language}.
sectionWhere: This is part {part} of {parts} of a longer meeting.
glossary: Project glossary (names and product terms; use these spellings): {glossary}
correctSystem:
You proofread automatic meeting transcripts. Speech recognition mishears words, people's names, company names and domain terms; you fix only those.
Rules:
- Fix only misheard words, names and domain terms. Use the spellings of the glossary and the speaker names.
- Never add, remove, reorder or rephrase content. Keep the speaker's wording, filler words and grammar as they are.
- Do not fix punctuation, style or grammar, and do not translate.
- Change a word only when the context makes the right word clear. When unsure, leave the segment as it is.
Answer with only a JSON array of the segments you changed: [{"i": index, "text": "the whole corrected text of the segment"}]. Leave out every segment you did not change. Answer [] when nothing needs a fix.
